result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast problem: white heading and subtitle text sit on a very pale mint-green background, making the offer nearly illegible. A couple of smaller consistency issues appear in the 'Fastest near you' cards.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' is rendered in white on a very light mint-green background, giving a contrast ratio far below the 4.5:1 (and 3:1 for large text) WCAG minimum. The text is barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., the dark green/near-black used elsewhere) on the pale green banner, or darken the banner background substantially so white text passes contrast requirements.

issues.description: The banner subtitle 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is small white text on the same pale green background, making the promo code and minimum-order condition effectively unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply a dark, high-contrast color to the subtitle text and verify at least 4.5:1 contrast against the banner background.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards include rating, ETA and cuisine. The inconsistent information density makes the top row feel incomplete compared to the rest of the page.
issues.suggestion: Add rating and/or cuisine tags to the 'Fastest near you' cards, or intentionally simplify both sections so the card metadata is consistent.

issues.description: The first carousel image (Green Bowl Poké) is a washed-out, low-contrast illustration on a near-white background, which looks visually flat and inconsistent next to the rich, dark photographic-style images of the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Use imagery with consistent saturation/background treatment across carousel cards, or add a subtle border/overlay so light images don't blend into the page background.
